name: every act has a word
headline: Every act has a *word*
visualData: type a name | a tile exists
present | the tile becomes a slideshow
website | the tile becomes a site
* say it again | teach it to a friend
say: And you do everything by saying it. The command line speaks plain words, with no symbols to remember. Type a name to make a tile. Say present, and a tile becomes a slideshow. Say website, and it becomes a site. Every act in Hypercomb has a word, so whatever you do, you can say again, teach to a friend, and remember. The language belongs to its community, too: people translate it into their own tongue, and their words travel to every hive that follows them.
